messages:
maria: quick sync — we need to align on the exact metric set and rollout plan for KV + prefix cache effectiveness dashboards. goal: a console page that answers hit rate, evictions, reuse-by-workload, and hot-prefixes w/ low cardinality. who owns which pieces? :eyes:
ajay: runtime here. rough sketch of what we emit from the serving process:
```
kvcache_prefix_requests_total{tenant="T", model="m1", workload="api", prefix_len="8"} 12345
kvcache_prefix_hits_total{...} 9876
kvcache_evictions_total{reason="memory",...} 34
kvcache_size_bytes{pool="gpu-0"} 123456789
```
we also can emit `kvcache_prefix_reuse_count` as a counter incremented when the same prefix is reused across requests in a short window. labels: tenant, model, route, prefix_len_bucket (1,2,4,8,16+), seq_len_bucket. keep label set small.

kevin: infra — +1 to these names but big warning: `tenant` x `model` x `route` x `prefix_len` is cardinality hell. we should only emit tenant for enterprise routes and otherwise emit `tenant_tier` (free/paid/enterprise) and a hashed tenant tag for sampling. propose two ingestion modes: full for Dedicated customers (low cardinality), sampled-10% for hosted. also prefer `kvcache_eviction_total{type="LRU|TTL|OOM"}` not free-form reasons.

tara: console/product — for UX, we want panels: global hit rate (time-series), heatmap of prefix_len vs hit rate, top-10 workloads by reuse, eviction rate by reason, and a sample query explorer. can you give PromQL prototypes? need stable metric names so dashboard can be implemented. also we want a per-model view and an overall tenant-level SLO.

ajay: proto PromQLs:
```
# global prefix hit rate (instant)
sum(kvcache_prefix_hits_total) / sum(kvcache_prefix_requests_total)

# per-workload reuse (rolling 5m)
sum by(workload)(increase(kvcache_prefix_reuse_count[5m])) / sum by(workload)(increase(kvcache_prefix_requests_total[5m]))

# eviction rate per 1k requests
(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]) / rate(kvcache_prefix_requests_total[5m])) * 1000
```
note: `increase()` on counters, use `rate()` for alerts.

kevin: also add a gauge `kvcache_active_prefixes` and `kvcache_kv_entries` to track memory vs cardinality. expose a `kvcache_prefix_cardinality_bucket{len_bucket="8"}` histogram? might be heavier. we can approximate with rare-event counting (HyperLogLog) but then dashboard needs interpretation.

maria: SLO/alerting proposals: fire a P2 if global prefix hit rate drops >15% from baseline for 15m AND eviction rate spikes >5x. For tenant-impacting alerts, only alert on enterprise tenants when tenant_tier==enterprise. We should define baseline windows (last 7d med).

tara: dashboard interactions: allow flipping sampling mode to view full-tenant data (for Dedicated) and a toggle to show hashed-tenants->resolved-tenant when you have perms. add a drilldown from prefix heatmap to example prompts that caused misses (sanitized).

ajay: instrumentation notes for runtime teams:
- emit counters at the point of decision: `prefix_match_attempt`, `prefix_hit`, `kv_lookup`, `kv_hit`, `eviction` with typed reasons
- annotate events with `workload` (route name), `model`, and `seq_len_bucket` only
- use prefix_len_bucket and avoid full prefix string in metrics (hash if needed)
- add a local sampling flag to only send tenant label for N% of requests to avoid high cardinality on hosted

kevin: ingestion pipeline: we will add a transform to translate `prefix_len` into `prefix_len_bucket` and drop labels under cardinality threshold. also add a cardinality alert if distinct label combinations > X for 1h. cost estimate: ~+5% metrics cost at 10% sampling, +40% if we enable per-tenant full labels globally.

maria: rollout plan draft:
1) week 0: runtime emits metrics behind feature flag, local test infra indexes them (no dashboard yet)
2) week 1: ingest transforms + cheap dashboard mocks (global panels only) internal usage
3) week 2: open dashboard to SRE/Platform + enable per-workload panels for Dedicated only
4) week 3-4: sampling live on hosted, add per-tenant drilldowns for opt-in customers
5) retrospective + adjust labels/buckets after 2 weeks of data

tara: can UX/console team start building panels with placeholder queries? i can do layout if you freeze metric names by Friday.

maria: yes freeze by Fri EOD is ideal. owners: runtime=ajay, infra/ingest=kevin, console=tara, PM= maria.

ingest-bot: deploy-notice: feature-flag `kvcache_metrics_v2` will be available in canary tomorrow 06:30 UTC.

kevin: action items I/O: I'll add a drop-transform prototype and cost calc doc.

ajay: I'll open a runtime PR with counters + unit tests and a small README showing labels and how to toggle sampling.

maria: i'll write the SLO language and add to alerts playbook. thanks all — milestone: freeze metric names by Fri, check-in Mon standup :thumbsup:
